title: No-cloning removes the teleportation and fission paradoxes

statements.text: Personal identity includes quantum states tied to prehensions. Neither teleportation nor fission can make exact copies of such a system because of the no-cloning theorem, so the paradoxes built on duplicate persons do not arise.

sources.quote: Neither teleportation nor fission can reproduce exact copies of the same system due to the no-cloning theorem of quantum states.
